subject: Ignite Analytics — POC onboarding & hands-on lab scheduling

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Ignite POC — kickoff & environment prep

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to get the hands-on POC scheduled. We typically run a 90-minute kickoff + working session that covers: prompt review, routing config, a short load test (150 concurrent reqs baseline), and verification of staging endpoints / API keys.

A couple of asks before we lock the calendar:
- Can you confirm who from your side will own firewall/allowlist work (IP + ports)?
- Can you provision a sandbox API key or tell us which staging endpoint we should target?
- Any calendar constraints for next week (Mon–Thu preferred) in PST?

I attached a brief scoping doc with the proposed agenda. Suggested slots: 2027-02-24 09:00–10:30 PT, 2027-02-24 13:00–14:30 PT, or 2027-02-25 10:00–11:30 PT.

If those don't work, send a few times and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: ignite-poc-scoping.docx (1 page)

Sean — thanks, this looks good.

We can do the session but need to shift the day: Wed 2027-02-25 11:00–12:30 PT would work better for our engineering leads. Patricia (CC) will own firewall/allowlist. Our DevOps team requests the following in advance:
- IP allowlist entries (we'll provide a CIDR range)
- Confirmation of which staging hostname you expect us to route to (staging.redwood.ignite-int)
- Any temporary service account credentials or SSO guidance for the session

Patricia — I can loop you into the runbook if helpful.

Liam
Head of Product | Ignite Analytics
liam.oconnor@igniteanalytics.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T14:35:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood environment checklist & suggested flow for Wed 2/25

Hi all — looping in a concise checklist for the hands-on session. I recommend we confirm the following items no later than 48 hours before the workshop so we can run the load test without surprises:

Pre-session (action items)
- DevOps: apply allowlist (IPs below) and open outbound port 443 to staging hosts.
- Ignite: provide a sandbox API key with token-scoped permissions and expiry of 7 days.
- Redwood: we will provide a temp service account for KV cache population and a small synthetic prompt set for quality checks.

Allowlist (example CIDRs)
- 34.210.0.0/16
- 52.23.128.0/17

Session flow (90 min)
1) 15m: Intro + goals (Sean)
2) 25m: Prompt walkthrough & routing policy selection (Marissa)
3) 25m: Hands-on traffic to staging + KV/cache checks (Vanessa)
4) 20m: Short load test (150 concurrent baseline) & results review (Stephanie)
5) 5m: Next steps + rollout plan

Attached: redwood-environment-setup-checklist.pdf (one-page runbook)

If Patricia could confirm the allowlist window and provide a contact phone for the firewall team that would be great.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-environment-setup-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-02-21T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Updated invite + runbook draft (v1)

Hi Liam — created the calendar invite for Wed 2027-02-25 11:00–12:30 PT and attached the first draft of the runbook. I've put placeholders for the staging hostname and the sandbox API key — will update once you share the details.

Runbook highlights:
- Connection check & basic generate (token + header example)
- Routing policy toggles we recommend for evaluation (latency vs cost)
- KV cache warm-up script and where to upload prompt seed data
- Load test commands (k6 script snippet) and expected thresholds

Attaching: ignite-poc-runbook-v1.md

Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
